unresolved.reason: No current Lebanese official source directly establishes a nationwide ordinary Israeli-passport tourist route. General Security's public visitor page does not provide an Israeli-passport baseline; an Israel-specific admission rule must not be inferred or flattened into visa_required.

General Security grants Ghanaian tourists a one-month border visa under ticket, accommodation/contact and funds conditions, but separately requires prior authorisation for female Ghanaian tourists. It does not establish one gender-neutral ordinary-passport outcome.

General Security grants Egyptian tourists a one-month border visa under ticket, accommodation/contact and funds conditions, but separately requires prior authorisation for female Egyptian tourists. It does not establish one gender-neutral ordinary-passport outcome.

The General Security page includes Iraq in a broad automatic-tourist list, while a later Iraq-specific provision makes automatic visas conditional for traders, doctors and engineers. The page does not reconcile those scopes into one nationality-only ordinary-passport route.

The HKSAR Immigration Department combines visa-free and visa-on-arrival outcomes for Egypt, so it cannot establish the normalized route. Egypt's live named eVisa roster does not directly assign HKSAR passports and no accessible current Ministry schedule clarifies the result.

Israel's official passport table says visa required but retains a Tabba-to-Sharm route exception. Egypt's named eVisa roster does not assign Israel and no current nationwide Egyptian ordinary-passport issuance baseline was reproducible; do not flatten the geographic split.

No current Egyptian or São Tomé and Príncipe official source directly establishes the ordinary short-visitor route or issuance timing. Egypt's named eVisa roster is not an exhaustive residual rule, and Ministry nationality schedules are inaccessible on replay.

No current Egyptian or Zimbabwean official source directly establishes the ordinary short-visitor route or issuance timing. Egypt's named eVisa roster is not an exhaustive residual rule, and Ministry nationality schedules are inaccessible on replay.

No current Egyptian or Jordanian official source directly establishes a nationwide ordinary Jordanian-passport tourist route and issuance timing. Egypt's named eVisa roster does not assign Jordan; conditional residence or tour routes cannot supply the passport-only baseline.

No current Egyptian or Angolan official source directly establishes the ordinary short-visitor route or issuance timing. Egypt's named eVisa roster does not assign Angola and has no explicit exhaustive complement; Ministry nationality schedules are inaccessible on replay.
